# Material_Circularity

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework for recycling and reusing advanced materials within manufacturing processes to minimize waste and dependency on scarce raw inputs. Supports sustainable and self-sufficient deployment of neuromorphic and topology-centric systems, where material constraints can bottleneck scalability.
